facts.fact: The second AfCFTA Digital Trade Forum, on implementing the AfCFTA Protocol on Digital Trade, was held in Lagos on 1-2 July 2026 with Nigeria's trade minister and the AfCFTA Secretary-General speaking (event date from the ingest note; the article was published 2026-08-05).

Nigeria's trade minister says Nigeria is a co-champion of the AfCFTA Protocol on Digital Trade and leads the Digital Trade Regulators' Working Group harmonising market entry and licensing across participating countries; stated at the July 2026 forum, article published 2026-08-05.
